verdict.rationale: Lindy runs scheduled and triggered routines, so error-handling paths and failure alerts are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents dedicated error workflows, failure branches, or notifications when a run fails. Routines and Slack diagnostics are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails
